justifications.fit: pyproject.toml:682 updates the escalator comment to the new model in the file's own voice and the diff adds no name the naming rules forbid.

justifications.reuse: the diff adds no production definition, and tests/core/test_gpt6_seat_rotation.py extends the single-seat pin at tests/core/test_settings.py:472 rather than duplicating an owned seat-resolution mechanism.
justifications.scope_discipline: all five changed files sit inside the declared write paths, with imas_codex/settings.py and tests/core/test_settings.py granted in resume-1-advice.txt.
